notes.title: Accidental Update
notes.notes: I recently pushed an update resulting in all puzzles being registered as completed. Obviously, this is undesirable, so it has been rolled back. This rollback, however, may result in a reset of the completion statistics in your save data. I am extremely sorry for any lost progress and have learned from my mistake. Any achievements will remain unlocked.

notes.title: Update 1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Mural tile transition to mural is now skippable by pressing any key
[*]Puzzle menus can now be navigated with arrow keys as well as A+D
[/list]
